results.title: Jack Dongarra Early Career Award - Welcome to ISC High Performance 2026
results.content: ## JACK DONGARRA EARLY CAREER AWARD. ## JACK DONGARRA EARLY CAREER. The ISC High Performance Jack Dongarra Early Career Award and Lecture Series is an annual event that honors the remarkable contributions of Professor Jack Dongarra to the field of high performance computing and the HPC community. The award focuses on outstanding individuals who have made exceptional contributions to high-performance computing, including numerical algorithms and software libraries, computational sciences, mathematics, and machine learning, and emerging technologies. The recipient will deliver a **25-minute talk** in the ISC Jack Dongarra Lecture Series, part of the ISC High Performance invited program. ISC 2026 Jack Dongarra Early Career Award Winner Devesh Tiwari. Devesh Tiwari, ISC 2026 Jack Dongarra Early Career Award Winner. **Devesh Tiwari** of Northeastern University, USA, has been selected as the recipient of the ISC 2026 Jack Dongarra Early Career Award. The award focuses on outstanding individuals who have made exceptional contributions to high-performance computing, including numerical algorithms and software libraries, computational sciences, mathematics, and machine learning.
